emails.subject: Quick question on AI recruiting workflow
emails.body:
Hi Jake,

I am building Hirelix for technical recruiters working on AI, ML, data, and software roles.

Acceler8 Talent's focus on high-growth AI and technology hiring looked very relevant. Hirelix is trying to improve one narrow part of the workflow: client JD in, evidence-backed technical shortlist out.

It ranks real profiles with fit reasons, risks to verify, and outreach context a recruiter can personalize before contacting candidates.

Would you be open to a quick look and blunt feedback on whether this would save review time for an AI recruiting desk?

Best,
Noah

Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
https://hirelix.online

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}
